title: Staff Engineer (Python, CI/CD)
description:

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer (Singapore/India)
description:
**Job Summary**
This role could be based in Singapore and India. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based
  
  

* Provide senior individual contributor ownership across DevSecOps, Application Security, AI Security and Digital Assets Security capabilities, ensuring security controls are embedded into engineering, platform and emerging technology workflows.
* Drive practical security enablement across ADO/SNC workflow enhancements, security tooling integration, AI model onboarding security activities, SBOM and software supply chain security, automation and pilot-to-production transition.
* Partner with AI Factory, ADO Platform, Security Architecture, application and engineering teams to align delivery priorities, manage cross-functional dependencies and support secure, scalable adoption of AI, Digital Assets and application security capabilities across the Bank.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Security capability ownership and delivery**

* Own and deliver critical security capabilities across AI Security, Digital Assets Security, DevSecOps and Application Security, ensuring delivery is aligned to committed roadmap outcomes, OKRs and business-critical security priorities.
* Drive security tooling integration, automation and workflow improvements across engineering platforms, with a focus on reducing manual effort, improving risk visibility and strengthening secure delivery practices.

**AI Security, Digital Assets and emerging technology enablement**

* Support AI model onboarding security activities, AI governance enablement, MCP security controls, model security tooling integration and AI Factory engagement to help accelerate secure AI adoption.
* Enable Digital Assets security outcomes by supporting security assurance for blockchain, smart contract and emerging technology use cases, including shift-left controls and early risk detection.

**DevSecOps, ADO/SNC workflows and software supply chain security**

* Enhance ADO/SNC-based workflows and pipeline-integrated controls to support shift-left security, vulnerability management, issue traceability and consistent remediation across application teams.
* Support SBOM Manager expansion, software supply chain security, SCA/OSS governance and component risk visibility to improve prioritised remediation and strengthen resilience against supply chain vulnerabilities.

**Stakeholder management, governance and operationalisation**

* Engage senior stakeholders across AI Factory, ADO Platform, AI Safety, Security Architecture, Digital Assets, application and engineering teams to manage dependencies, unblock delivery issues and drive alignment on security priorities.
* Transition successful PoVs and pilots into sustainable operating models with clear ownership, adoption plans, evidence generation, service measures and BAU handover where applicable.
* Provide timely visibility of delivery risks, material control gaps, roadmap slippage and governance dependencies, escalating where required to protect business-critical security outcomes.

**Motivations**

* Energised by solving complex security problems at the intersection of engineering, automation, AI, Digital Assets and enterprise risk.
* Motivated to make security practical and consumable for delivery teams by embedding controls into existing developer, platform and governance workflows.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with evolving technologies, senior stakeholders, cross-functional dependencies and a strong focus on measurable delivery outcomes.

**Our Ideal Candidate**

* 15+ years’ experience across software engineering, Application Security, DevSecOps or security engineering in large-scale enterprise environments, preferably including regulated financial services.
* Strong software development background with hands-on proficiency in Node.js, Java or Python, with the ability to review code, understand engineering patterns and translate security requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong experience in AI Security and emerging technology risk, including secure AI adoption, AI model onboarding, AI governance controls, model security assessment and tooling, LLM/VLM/ML security, MCP security and AI-enabled application risks.
* Proven ability to define and operationalise security guardrails for emerging technologies, working across AI Factory, AI Safety, Security Architecture, platform and application engineering teams.
* Strong hands-on experience embedding security controls into CI/CD pipelines and engineering workflows, preferably using Azure DevOps or an equivalent enterprise platform.
* Deep knowledge of secure SDLC and Application Security, including SAST, SCA/OSS, secrets detection, vulnerability management, remediation workflows and secure-by-design practices.
* Practical experience designing or integrating security automation and tooling across developer, platform and governance workflows, focusing on control effectiveness, risk visibility and developer experience.
* Sound understanding of software supply chain security, including SBOM, component risk, open-source governance and dependency remediation.
* Exposure to Digital Assets or blockchain security, including smart-contract security and associated technology risks, would be advantageous.
* Proven ability to evaluate and operationalise new security capabilities, taking initiatives from proof of value or pilot through production adoption and sustainable BAU ownership.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to operate independently, manage cross-functional dependencies and influence senior stakeholders across security, engineering, architecture, risk and governance teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage ambiguity, balance competing priorities and provide clear, risk-based recommendations.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, CCSP, AWS/Azure security or architecture certifications are preferred but not mandatory.

**Role Specific Technical Skills And Competencies**

* AI Security and Emerging Technology Risk
* Software Development (Node.js, Java or Python)
* Application Security and Secure SDLC
* DevSecOps and CI/CD Security Automation
* Digital Assets and Blockchain Security
* Software Supply Chain Security and SBOM
* Security Tooling Integration and Automation
* Stakeholder Management and Delivery Governance

title: Specialist, Technology - Software
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Strong software architecture expertise designing complex, distributed, scalable, high-performance, and data-intensive systems.
* Experience across legacy and modern technology stacks, with the ability to evolve existing platforms and drive architectural improvements.
* Deep technical knowledge in one or more areas: enterprise architecture, cloud-native services, microservices, AI/ML infrastructure, big data platforms, or DevOps automation.
* Proven ability to design and deliver medium-to-large scale software systems in multi-developer, cross-functional environments.
* Strong systems thinking and analytical skills, capable of simplifying ambiguity, evaluating trade-offs, and solving complex technical challenges.
* Expertise in scalability, performance optimization, reliability, and future-proof software design, ensuring robust architectures, code quality, and maintainability.
* Ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into architecture, detailed designs, and executable engineering plans.
* Strong technical leadership and mentoring skills, influencing architects, senior engineers, and technical leads across organizations, geographies, and disciplines.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, effectively engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders in global teams.
* Ownership-driven mindset with a focus on execution, innovation, and engineering excellence, leveraging modern development practices and AI-assisted engineering tools.

* Experience building and architecting complex distributed systems.

title: Princ Engr-AI Science
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing…**
As a Principal Engineer (Agentic & Applied AI), you will serve as a technical leader and individual performer, architecting and driving end-to-end solutions for complex AI and Agentic use cases across multiple concurrent projects. You will be hands-on in design and coding, while leading project pods with one or two junior engineers or data scientists.
  
  

* Leading the architecture, design, and end-to-end development of complex Agentic AI and traditional AI/ML solutions across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Working in a collaborative environment with global teams and managing cross-functional stakeholders across business and technical domains to deliver scalable solutions to high-impact business problems.
* Architecting, developing, and deploying LLM-driven applications, multi-agent workflows, autonomous agent systems, and traditional data science models into production environments.
* Translating complex business requirements into robust technical and system architectures, creating high-level and low-level design documents, and articulating architectural decisions and findings to leadership and stakeholders.
* Hands-on coding and system implementation using Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), REST/gRPC APIs, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka.
* Guiding, mentoring, and technical coaching of junior engineers and data scientists on project pods—conducting peer code and architecture reviews, sharing constructive feedback, and driving the team toward best-in-class technical execution
* Designing and implementing robust testing, validation, evaluation, and observability frameworks (e.g., LLM evals, hallucination mitigation, latency/token optimization, model governance) across the end-to-end AI lifecycle.
* Developing next-generation AI systems with built-in data privacy, ethical AI, bias mitigation, guardrails, and compliance with enterprise security and governance policies.
* Assisting in growing the AI practice by leading POCs, identifying new high-value opportunities, defining architectural blueprints, evaluating emerging tools/frameworks, and contributing to technical white papers and documentation.
* Staying informed on the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic frameworks, and related tech stacks, finding ways to deliver business value by customizing and applying them to our specific enterprise domain.
* Partnering with ecosystem partners, startups, and open-source communities to explore and integrate cutting-edge AI capabilities.

**What We’re Looking For...**
You have deep technical expertise in modern AI engineering and traditional data science, and you thrive as a hands-on technical lead who bridges architecture, coding, and stakeholder collaboration. You are energized by working in a dynamic environment, handling multiple complex projects simultaneously, and translating ambiguous business problems into reliable, production-ready AI systems. You take pride in technical excellence, enjoy mentoring junior team members, and are passionate about advancing state-of-the-art Agentic and LLM architectures within an enterprise scale.
  
  
**What we're looking for… ("You'll need to have…")**

* Bachelor's degree with six or more years of relevant experience.
* Five or more years of hands-on experience in software engineering, applied machine learning, or advanced data science in production environments.
* One or more years of hands-on experience architecting, building, and deploying Agentic AI and LLM-driven solutions (e.g., autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, tool calling/function calling, agent workflows).
* Strong hands-on proficiency with modern AI orchestration and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agent frameworks.
* Deep familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture, tool integration standards, REST/gRPC APIs, and microservices design.
* Expert-level coding proficiency in Python and solid software engineering practices (OOP, design patterns, modular architecture, CI/CD, testing, code quality).
* Strong experience working with relational, analytical, and streaming data stores: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka.
* Solid foundation and working understanding of traditional data science methodologies, predictive modeling, machine learning concepts (supervised/unsupervised learning, neural networks, ensembling), and evaluation metrics.
* Experience with all phases of an end-to-end AI project lifecycle: data ingestion/streaming, preprocessing, prompt engineering/fine-tuning, model validation/evals, containerization, deployment, operationalization, monitoring, and tracing.
* Demonstrated track record of leading technical implementation across multiple simultaneous projects and collaborating effectively with cross-functional business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience providing technical mentorship, conducting architectural and code reviews, and giving feedback to junior engineers and data scientists.

**What we're looking for… ("Even better if you have…")**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience architecting and deploying AI/ML and Agentic solutions in the Telecommunications domain or large-scale enterprise environments.
* Experience with Vector Databases and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques (hybrid search, reranking, contextual compression).
* Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and guardrail systems
* Experience with cloud AI platforms (GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI) and distributed compute/data infrastructure.
* Experience in optimization, simulation techniques, or operations research applied to enterprise problems.
* Active contributions to open-source AI projects, agent frameworks, or authoring technical white papers and publications.
* Exceptional presentation, communication, and executive storytelling skills with a proven ability to influence technical and non-technical leadership.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Director - Cloud Platform Operations, Reliability & Security
description:
**Location**
Chennai, India; relocation can be discussed

**Experience 15**
+ years in technology, including substantial executive leadership

**Reporting**
Senior technology leadership

**The mandate**

An established enterprise software organization is strengthening the way it builds, protects, and operates its cloud services. It is looking for an executive who can bring platform engineering, production resilience, and security outcomes under clear leadership, while working closely with product and engineering teams.

The successful leader will set direction and build a capable organization that delivers dependable services, reduces security exposure, and automates routine operational work. This is a leadership appointment with real technical accountability: the executive will challenge design decisions, examine service and security evidence, and personally engage in critical events when needed.

**What you will own**

An integrated operating model for cloud platforms, service operations, SRE, secure software delivery, and security engineering.

Organization design, leadership development, and measurable accountability across managers and specialist teams.

The executive view of service health, operational risk, security posture, major incidents, and investment priorities.

A close partnership with engineering leaders so reliability and security are built into architecture, development, release, and support.

**Areas of impact**

**Service resilience and operational leadership**

Define how critical services are measured and operated, including SLOs, error budgets, availability, performance, capacity, and release risk.

Lead high-severity incident response and 24x7 escalation. Set expectations for command, communications, root-cause analysis, and completion of corrective work.

Use telemetry, service reviews, readiness practices, and resilience exercises to identify weak signals and prevent customer-impacting failures.

Build repeatable operating practices for change management, on-call readiness, escalation, and continual service improvement.

**Cloud platform and financial stewardship**

Guide the architecture and operating model for OCI or an equivalent major provider such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Oversee Kubernetes and virtualized environments, microservices foundations, cloud networking, databases, provisioning, and platform lifecycle.

Expand infrastructure as code and policy as code to make environments consistent, reviewable, and controlled.

Ensure backups and disaster recovery are routinely tested against agreed recovery objectives; improve resilience based on exercise results.

Introduce sound cloud financial management through cost allocation, forecasting, capacity choices, rightsizing, and accountable spend.

**Security engineering and threat response**

Own identity and privileged-access practices, secrets handling, and least-privilege design across cloud and engineering environments.

Ensure application and API authorization testing addresses tenant boundaries, isolation, and access-control failures in multi-tenant services.

Operate a risk-based vulnerability program that assigns owners, sets remediation targets, verifies fixes, and escalates overdue exposure.

Maintain cloud security posture management, continuous monitoring, security incident response, and disciplined penetration-test follow-through.

**Secure delivery, assurance, and AI operations**

Work with software engineering to embed automated checks in CI/CD: SAST, DAST, SCA, secret detection, container scanning, and IaC scanning.

Agree practical remediation SLAs and risk exceptions with engineering teams, keeping controls effective and delivery workflows usable.

Maintain operating evidence for ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and SOC 2; lead customer security assessments and responses.

Apply automation and AIOps to detection, triage, response, and toil reduction. For AI agents, establish identity controls, authorized tool access, isolated execution, complete audit trails, and human approvals for sensitive actions.

**Experience and leadership profile**

At least 20 years of technology experience, with a track record of senior ownership in cloud platforms, production operations, reliability engineering, DevSecOps, or security engineering.

Executive leadership across multiple functions, including managing managers, setting direction, building leadership capability, and delivering outcomes through sizeable teams.

Accountability for business-critical production services; product SaaS or other cloud-native, multi-tenant environments are especially relevant.

Practical depth in a major cloud provider, Kubernetes, microservices, networking, databases, observability, IaC, and recovery planning.

Credible record of leading significant production incidents and converting lessons into lasting changes to architecture, process, or operational readiness.

Applied security engineering experience spanning IAM/PAM, secrets, application and API authorization, vulnerability remediation, cloud posture, monitoring, and response.

Experience introducing automated CI/CD security checks and achieving sustained remediation without relying on manual review as the main control.

Experience leading ISO 27001-family and SOC 2 assurance, including evidence quality and customer-facing security reviews.

Ability to communicate technical risks, trade-offs, service performance, and investment needs clearly to executive stakeholders.

**Additional strengths**

Production experience with OCI; equivalent leadership depth with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud is applicable.

Background in enterprise SaaS or a regulated, security-conscious technology environment.

Relevant cloud, security, SRE, or audit credentials, such as cloud architecture/security certifications, CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.

Demonstrated use of AIOps or AI agents in operational settings with clear boundaries, oversight, and auditability.

description:

If you excel at communication, collaboration, and unrelenting innovation, we want to talk to you. And if you bring dedication, positive energy and integrity to the table, you just might be the right fit for our team.
  
  
**Qualifications**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities (Other Duties May Be Assigned)**

* Lead architecture reviews and provide technical direction to engineering, cloud, security, data, and product teams.

****Technical Requirements:****

* 12+ years of experience in software engineering or application delivery, including significant experience as a Solution Architect or Technical Architect.
* Strong experience designing secure, scalable, resilient, and highly available cloud-native applications, preferably on AWS.
* Good understanding of Generative AI concepts, including Large Language Models, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and AI agents.
* Experience defining solution architectures for microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, enterprise integrations, and SaaS applications.
* Good working knowledge of Java and Python, with the ability to review technical designs and guide engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, data privacy, observability, performance, and cost optimisation.
* Experience creating architecture diagrams, solution design documents, technology evaluations, and architecture decision records.
* Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and technical leadership skills, with the ability to explain complex solutions to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Experience and/or Education Qualification:**

* Undergraduate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required, with graduate degree preferred
* 12+ years of overall experience in Application/Solution Development domain
* Experience building Cloud Native Applications
* Expert hands-on proficiency in Developing Applications using one or more technology stacks
* Strong hands-on understanding of scalability, security, high availability and operational requirements
* Experience with full product lifecycle
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

****Why apply?****

* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
* Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves to feel appreciated and accepted.

This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.
  
  
HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation.
  
  
**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
  
  
When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.#ZEOLife at ZuoraAs an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that title: Director-Software Engineering-Unify Energy
description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle.
  
  
The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data-intensive solutions for regulated or asset-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities.
* Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long-term platform direction.
* Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans.
* Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement.
* Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting.
* Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers’ physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows.
* Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer-specific systems of record.
* Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption.
* Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity.
* Establish outcome-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact.
* Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service-level objectives, and operational readiness.
* Monitor portfolio health, delivery metrics, product quality, reliability, risks, dependencies, capacity, and technical debt; make clear tradeoffs and proactively resolve or escalate issues that threaten business outcomes.
* Continuously improve platform architecture, technical health, and integration patterns while protecting customer continuity and sequencing change based on value, risk, and delivery readiness.
* Support talent planning through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and the creation of an accountable, inclusive, and customer-focused engineering culture.
* Represent Unify Energy engineering in executive, product, customer, and governance forums, providing clear updates on strategy, delivery performance, investment needs, risks, opportunities, and decisions required.
* Stay current with emerging trends in energy technology, information management, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data platforms, AI-enabled automation, SaaS architecture, and software delivery practices.

**First 6-12 Months**
The initial focus will be to establish a clear engineering and product delivery baseline for Unify Energy, strengthen alignment between customer needs and the technical roadmap, and improve execution predictability. The Director will assess the platform architecture, team capabilities, operating model, delivery commitments, reliability, security posture, technical debt, and customer integration landscape. They will work closely with Product, Operations, and customer-facing teams to confirm the highest-priority business and product outcomes and translate them into a focused, sequenced delivery plan.
  
  
Success will be demonstrated through clearer accountability, stronger engineering and product operating rhythms, improved delivery and quality metrics, reduced execution risk, deeper customer partnership, and measurable progress on the highest-value Unify Energy capabilities.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About the role

You will be the architect who wins the technical deal. Before a contract is signed, you show enterprise customers that their AI agents will work, at their scale and under their rules. You build the demos and proofs of concept, answer the architecture questions, and hand delivery a plan they can execute. This is a hands-on engineering role in front of customers. You write code most weeks and spend the rest with CIOs, platform teams and risk officers. You report to the Co-Founder and CTO.

What you will do

• Discover: run technical discovery with CIOs, platform-engineering and risk teams at banks, insurers and asset managers. Map their systems, data and controls to the agent use cases that matter.

• Demo: build tailored demos of agent workflows, using the customer's own scenarios where you can.

• Prove: scope and deliver 2 to 6 week proofs of concept. Write the code, wire up integrations and measure results against agreed success criteria.

• Design: produce reference architectures for agent deployment on AWS, Azure or GCP, covering identity, data access, observability and guardrails.

• De-risk: answer security, compliance and model-risk questionnaires (SOC 2, data residency, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls).

• Hand off: turn every won proof of concept into a delivery plan our forward-deployed engineers can run from day one.

• Feed back: bring field patterns to product and build reusable demo assets, templates and starter agents.

What we are looking for

• 8+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, solutions architecture or forward-deployed engineering for enterprise customers.

• Hands-on experience building LLM applications or agents: prompt and tool design, RAG, evaluation, and at least one agent framework.

• Strong Python, plus working knowledge of APIs, containers and one major cloud.

• Comfort in regulated environments, where governance, auditability and access control decide the deal.

• Consulting experience: client-facing work, scoping engagements and running workshops with enterprise stakeholders.

• Understanding of tool calling and MCP, guardrails and policy controls, access management, observability and audit trails.

Nice to have

• Experience selling to, or working inside, financial services.

• Kubernetes, observability or AIOps tooling.

• AWS, Azure or GCP certifications.

• A public demo, repo, talk or post about something you built with agents.

Location: Chennai, India (Chennai office), hybrid 3 days on-site, with travel to customer sites as needed.

Moring helps enterprises put AI agents into production safely.

description:
**Associate Senior Solutions Architect**
Job #: req38675
  
  
Organization: World Bank

Required Language(s): English

Closing Date: 10/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
  
  
**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w
  
  
**Department Context**
The ITS Operations Products unit (ITSOP) enables the Bank's operational business processes through modern, flexible and user-friendly digital products. Its portfolio includes Operations Workspace and related solutions that bring together operational data, documents, workflows, collaboration and decision support for front-line staff.
  
  
ITSOP is seeking an Associate Senior Solutions Architect to provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership for the Operations Workspace ecosystem. The successful candidate will combine deep Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse expertise with strong .NET and Azure engineering skills, personally implement prototypes and reference solutions, and guide delivery teams from design through production. The role will also help integrate Generative AI and agentic capabilities into operational workflows using a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC). This is not a purely advisory role.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect translates complex operational requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET, Azure, APIs, data platforms and AI services. The role defines architecture, validates choices through working code, establishes reusable patterns and guardrails, and remains directly engaged in troubleshooting, CI/CD, release readiness and production improvement.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect works across multiple projects in the World Bank Operations portfolio and is accountable for ensuring that technical solutions are successfully designed, delivered and operated for Operations staff.
  
  
From a work-program perspective, the role provides technical leadership, delivery oversight and practical guidance to internal staff and globally distributed vendor teams. The architect helps sequence technical work, resolves delivery constraints and ensures that implementation remains aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards and release commitments.
  
  
From a technical perspective, the role leads application, integration and data architecture; identifies solution components and reusable patterns; validates designs through working prototypes; performs quality and code reviews; and remains accountable for delivery at speed, scale and quality.
  
  
**Role Scope and Distinction**

* Acts as a senior technical subject matter expert for complex, business-critical solutions in the Operations Workspace portfolio.
* Balances strategic architecture with recent, demonstrable hands-on contribution to prototypes, code, integration, deployment and technical problem-solving.
* Leads cross-layer design decisions involving applications, workflows, data, APIs, identity, security, observability and AI-enabled experiences.
* Guides multidisciplinary teams and vendors, mentors architects and engineers, and raises engineering quality through practical standards and reusable implementation assets.
* Works across globally distributed business, product, architecture, security, data, platform and engineering stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Operations Workspace and related products, aligning business outcomes, enterprise principles, security requirements and delivery constraints.
* Define target-state and transition architectures, solution options, architecture decision records, integration contracts, non-functional requirements and implementation roadmaps.
* Review designs and code for scalability, resilience, maintainability, interoperability, usability, performance and cost effectiveness.
* Identify systemic risks and technical debt, propose pragmatic remediation, and guide Agile Release Train and product teams through implementation trade-offs.

Lead solution delivery teams through implementation, maintenance, release readiness and operational improvement of business-critical applications supporting Operations Workspace and related Operations product ecosystems.
  
  
Lead application and data architecture modelling, component identification and solution quality reviews, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and approved technology standards.
  
  
**Dynamics 365 and Dataverse Engineering**

* Architect and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse solutions, including data models, security roles, business rules, workflows, plug-ins, custom actions, Power Platform components and environment strategy.
* Design supported extension patterns using C#/.NET, the Dataverse SDK and APIs while minimizing fragile customization and preserving upgradeability.
* Guide integration of Dynamics 365 with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, enterprise data products and other operational systems.
* Define application lifecycle management practices for solutions, configuration, environment variables, connection references, test data and controlled promotion across environments.

**Hands-on Prototyping and .NET Engineering**

* Personally design, code, test and demonstrate proofs of concept, technical spikes, reference implementations and minimum viable solutions.
* Develop secure APIs, services, plug-ins and integration components using C#, modern .NET, ASP.NET Core and RESTful patterns.
* Validate architecture choices through executable prototypes, performance tests and failure-mode testing before major delivery investment.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across user experience, application, integration, identity, data and infrastructure layers, and support teams during critical releases.

**Integration, Cloud and Platform Architecture**

* Design API-led, event-driven and workflow-based integrations using appropriate Azure services, API management, messaging, serverless and container patterns.
* Apply identity-first design using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege, secrets management and auditable authorization patterns, including B2E and approved external-access scenarios.
* Define observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards and actionable alerts across application and integration components.
* Collaborate with data and platform teams to connect operational applications to governed data services, analytics products and structured and unstructured enterprise information.

Design integrations with institutional systems and data platforms, including financing, trust funds, board operations, budgeting, SAP and enterprise data services, using supported APIs, events and workflow patterns.
  
  
Architect document and content-management integrations across Dynamics 365, SharePoint Online and approved cloud services, including secure storage, metadata, retrieval and downstream AI processing.
  
  
**Agentic AI and AI-enabled Operations**

* Design and prototype AI-enabled features and agentic workflows embedded in Operations Workspace, with explicit task boundaries, approved tools, controlled permissions, human review and failure handling.
* Integrate agents with Dynamics 365, enterprise APIs, documents, data platforms and business workflows using secure tool calling, structured outputs and reusable orchestration patterns.
* Apply retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence and knowledge-grounding approaches where they improve operational workflows and decision support.
* Define evaluation, telemetry and guardrails for groundedness, task success, safety, latency, reliability and cost, and ensure Responsible AI, privacy, records and security requirements are addressed.

Partner with information security teams on architecture reviews, threat modelling, control implementation, security testing and remediation evidence required for production approval.
  
  
**Delivery Lifecycle, CI/CD and Engineering Excellence**

* Establish and improve CI/CD pipelines for Dynamics 365 solutions, .NET services, infrastructure configuration and AI components using Azure DevOps or equivalent enterprise tooling.
* Embed automated unit, integration, contract, security, regression and performance testing into delivery pipelines, with quality gates, approvals, release evidence and rollback approaches.
* Apply both the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC), covering use-case framing, data and grounding readiness, prompt and tool versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and change control.
* Create reusable templates, starter repositories, SDKs, reference pipelines, coding standards and implementation guidance that improve developer productivity and consistency.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Team Leadership**

* Translate operational needs into feasible technical choices and communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Provide practical technical direction to internal teams and vendors, review deliverables against agreed architecture and quality expectations, and intervene hands-on where necessary.
* Mentor architects and engineers through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, demonstrations and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Partner with product leadership to sequence enablers, reduce delivery risk and ensure technical work results in measurable operational value.

Provide work-program oversight for internal and vendor delivery teams across locations, assess deliverable quality, remove technical blockers and hold suppliers accountable for agreed architecture, engineering and documentation standards.
  
  
Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master's degree with at least eight years of relevant experience, or bachelor's degree with at least ten years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related field.
* Substantial recent experience architecting and delivering large-scale enterprise applications using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET and Azure.
* Demonstrated hands-on contribution to production solutions, including personal coding, prototyping, integration, troubleshooting and deployment responsibilities.
* Experience leading complex delivery across internal staff, vendors and globally distributed teams in environments with strong governance, security and operational requirements.
* At least seven years of experience developing and maintaining large-scale solutions using C# and the Microsoft .NET ecosystem.
* At least five years of experience architecting Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Dataverse solutions and integrations with SharePoint Online, Azure services and enterprise or on-premises systems.
* Proven experience leading large, complex technical deliverables and globally distributed development teams, including vendor or offshore delivery, in environments with shifting priorities and multi-layered governance.

**Required Technical Capabilities**

* Advanced Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse architecture, including data modelling, security, workflows, plug-ins, custom APIs, Power Platform extensibility and solution ALM.
* Advanced C# and modern .NET engineering, including ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, automated testing and secure coding.
* Strong Azure application architecture experience, including App Service, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, storage and container-based deployment patterns.
* Strong systems integration capability across APIs, events, enterprise applications, Microsoft 365 services, SharePoint Online and data platforms.
* Hands-on CI/CD and DevSecOps experience, including source control, branching, build and release pipelines, infrastructure/configuration automation, quality gates, secrets handling and rollback.
* Practical experience designing or implementing Generative AI and agentic capabilities, including tool calling, orchestration, retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation, observability and human oversight.
* Ability to apply SDLC and ADLC controls to move prototypes into secure, supportable and production-ready services.
* Strong security architecture knowledge covering identity, authorization, least privilege, data protection, auditability, threat modelling and secure integration.
* Ability to produce clear architecture documentation and to explain decisions, alternatives, risks and trade-offs to varied audiences.
* Hands-on experience extending Dynamics 365 using C#/.NET plug-ins, custom APIs, workflows and supported client-side technologies, with strong knowledge of Dataverse security, data modelling and reporting capabilities.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, including B2E and approved B2B scenarios.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Operations Workspace, operational process platforms, project or portfolio management solutions, or comparable enterprise CRM/workflow ecosystems.
* Experience with Angular or React and modern web application integration with .NET and Dynamics 365 back ends.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or comparable enterprise agent frameworks.
* Experience with document intelligence, enterprise search, RAG, semantic layers, knowledge graphs or governed access to structured and unstructured information.
* Experience with SAFe, Agile Release Trains, product operating models and architecture governance.
* Experience in international development, financial services or another regulated environment with strong privacy, security and audit requirements.
* Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, DevOps, security or architecture certifications.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data and analytics platforms, including data lakes, data warehouses, Power BI, Azure Data Factory, Databricks or comparable integration and analytics services.

**Recommended Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert or relevant Dynamics 365 certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert.
* SAFe for Architects (ARCH) and/or SAFe DevOps (SDP).
* Relevant Microsoft applied skills or certifications in Azure AI, Azure OpenAI or Copilot Studio.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:
  
  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes**

* Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
* Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
* Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

World Bank Group Core Competencies
  
  
The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.

* Lifecycle Governance: Provide technical oversight and governance across the entire software development lifecycle, from strategic planning and analysis to deployment and long-term support.
* Cloud & Containerization Strategy: Define and enforce best practices for containerization (ECS, Kubernetes), cloud-native deployment, and infrastructure-as-code practices to build scalable and automated CI/CD pipelines.
* Agile Leadership: Champion and refine Agile best practices within and across teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and engineering excellence.
* Code Quality & Security Governance: Establish and enforce stringent standards for code quality, performance, and security. Lead security architecture reviews and mandate measures to mitigate risks.
* Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Act as a key technical visionary for the organization. Mentor and develop senior engineers and team leads, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
* Risk & Compliance Oversight: Drive a culture of proactive risk management and robust compliance. Ensure architectural decisions and development practices align with all applicable laws, policies, and ethical standards.

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

* Experience: 10-15 years of progressive experience in software engineering, with a significant focus on systems architecture and technical leadership.
* Core Java Mastery: Mastery of Core Java, including deep expertise in advanced concurrency, performance optimization, JVM internals, and the latest language features.
* Architectural Leadership: Proven track record of designing and delivering complex, distributed, and scalable enterprise systems.

* Event-Driven Systems: Proven experience architecting and managing large-scale, highly available event-driven systems using Kafka.
* Database Architecture: Expertise in database architecture (SQL and NoSQL), advanced performance tuning, and complex data modeling.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* AI & Prompt Engineering: Strategic experience in leveraging smart AI tools and prompt engineering to accelerate development cycles, improve code quality, and drive analytics.

title: Staff/Senior Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees:**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
  
  
**About the Role:**
To support the delivery of CloudBees products (both internal and external), our Operations team designs, deploys, secures and manages a variety of software systems and the related GCP / AWS infrastructure that underpins these software engineering objectives. Our guiding principle is simple - “Make Engineering Faster”. Underpinning this are the challenges of security, process change, technical change that all must be met to varying degrees. Further, we are passionate about reducing the manual work that plagues IT teams - Engineering / Ops / Support / Security - and are empowered to re-engineer processes and technology to achieve those objectives.
  
  
We are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Is able to troubleshoot complex issues calmly.
* An open communicator, capable of bringing new ideas to the team
* Is able to learn from colleagues at all levels
* Understands, and is motivated by, rapidly changing technologies and has demonstrable competence with modern AI tools.

You are:
  
  

* self-motivated and enjoy solving problems
* excited by the opportunity to automate yourself out of recurring workable to self-organize and document your work and decisions effectively
* You will liaise directly with the software engineers across all teams, ensuring that decisions are agreed internally and externally to Operations and that they meet our technical and non-technical objectives.

How you’ll work:
  
  

* In a geographically distributed team (APAC, US, EMEA) of peers
* Choose your own work in tandem with the team, team-leader, and manager
* Flexible working hours - while there will be some core hours required for meeting with Engineering and Operations teams - much latitude is given in getting work done.
* Hybrid work based out of our Chennai hub

**Requirements**

**Team-building**
- inside the team and across teams - you’ll be proposing new ideas and helping implement them
**Thinking**
- coming up with new ways of solving problems - and working with the team to prove them out and then implement them. Keeping up to speed with the latest technology, and proactively making use of tools like coding assistants and AI agents to accelerate your work.
**Documenting**
- describing problems, how your proposed solution solves those problems, and how your implemented solutions are operated.
**Optimizing**
- working with Engineering teams to optimize their build systems. Managing and developing tools which enable Engineers to ship faster.
**Defining**
- writing / modifying Terraform to handle our infrastructure, and helping teams define their infrastructure using our modules.
**Coding**
- you’ll be writing code in Golang - we occasionally write code in TypeScript, Python, and Groovy
**Securing**

* working with our security team to drive operational change in engineering teams
* working with our security team to drive organizational security changes (logging, auditing, monitoring, alerting)

**Observing**
- adding the right monitoring so that we are alerted before our customers notice, and not alerted when the system is able to heal itself
**Alerting**
- getting alerts and working with team members to solve the initial problem, documenting the problem and then working out how to stop them happening again
**DevOps / DevSecOps**
- We’re not “DevOps” engineers, but we do help our teams become more proficient in doing Dev and Ops (and embracing Total Ownership). We build the guard rails to help them do it safely and align tech-stacks across the company.
**What you will work on**
-
  
  

* IaaS - GCP, AWS
* AI tooling and automation - Claude Code, Codex, AWS Bedrock Agentcore, Software Factories
* Platform tools - Kubernetes, terraform, helm, docker
* Language tools - Golang
* Engineering tools - Jenkins, Backstage
* Operations tools - PagerDuty, DataDog

**Role Requirements:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or related field
* 8+ years working in a DevOps style environment - building automations, writing software, solving problems
* 2+ years working in AWS (preferred) or GCP
* 2+ years experience in a high level programming language (Golang / Python / Ruby / Java or similar)
* Experience of working asynchronously in a distributed team.
* Experience of contributing to your team’s technical strategy
* Strong self organization skills and communication skills

You have experience in:
  
  

* programming in various languages and domains
* Development with agentic AI and administration of tools
* the "modern Ops stack" (e.g. monitoring, alerting, cloud-based provisioning, Docker, Kubernetes)
* Linux systems administration
* cloud-based operations (GCP, AWS, or Azure)
* cluster orchestration and management tools (e.g. k8s / ECS / Terraform / etc)
* continuous integration / continuous delivery tools (Jenkins / Tekton etc)
* modern software engineering practices: code reviews, unit / acceptance testing, source control, etc.
* You have experience using work tools like GSuite, GitHub, Jira, Confluence, and Slack.
* Experience of managing and responding to production incidents

title: Servicenow-Application Engineer

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Application Engineer - III**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.
* Translates technical specifications into code for complex new or enhancement projects for internal clients. Writes programs, develops code, tests artifacts, and produces reports. Employs software development techniques to ensure tests are implemented in a way that support automation.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.
* Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues.
* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.
* Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
