title: Senior Engineer- Dot Net
description:
**About Us**
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
  
  
As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
  
  
**About Energy Systems**
We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production-grade software products and shared platform capabilities within DNV’s Digital & Transformation organization. This role sits within the Application Engineering section and contributes to the development and modernization of scalable web applications that support digital delivery across Energy Systems.
  
  
This role helps to advance how DNV performs Due Diligence, Verification & Assurance, and Renewables Certification work across Energy Systems.
  
  
This is not a project-based delivery or staff-augmentation role. Engineers are expected to develop deep product knowledge and remain accountable for the quality, maintainability, and operation of the software they build.
  
  
Working in close partnership with Frontend Engineers, Product leadership, Data & AI Engineering, Solution Engineering, Platform Reliability, Solution Architecture, and Platform Security & Compliance, this role helps bring application capabilities, data services, AI-enabled features, workflows, and APIs into one cohesive platform and product experience.
  
  
The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports scalable software across a modern Microsoft-oriented full-stack environment. The primary stack includes C# and .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, MySQL, Redis, TypeScript, React, Redux, Tailwind CSS, Docker, .NET Aspire, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, and Azure DevOps. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical cloud experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across globally distributed teams.
  
  
This role supports custom software development, application modernization, and integration with low-code or hybrid development environments, helping establish shared patterns, APIs, reusable components, and maintainable application architecture across the platform.
  
  
\*\*This role is based at our DNV office in Chennai, India. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.\*\*
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Software Engineering & Delivery**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable application and platform capabilities using modern software engineering practices.
* Build cohesive product experiences across backend services, APIs and platform integrations.
* Work directly with Product and Architecture stakeholders to shape requirements, evaluate technical approaches, and translate product direction into maintainable, production-ready software.
* Participate actively in code reviews, technical design discussions, estimation, delivery planning, and implementation decisions.
* Write clean, well-structured, testable, and maintainable code that supports long-term product quality and team velocity.
* Own product capabilities through design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and iterative improvement rather than treating delivery as complete when the initial feature is released.
* NET Application Development
* Develop modern API capabilities using C#, .NET 10, Entity Framework Core, SignalR, and related technologies.
* Develop solutions for Azure and contribute to their deployment and support.
* Support application modernization efforts, including refactoring, technical debt reduction, framework upgrades, and migration from legacy patterns where appropriate.
* Develop application capabilities used for structured review workflows, real-time collaboration, issue tracking, customer interaction, reporting, and delivery of technical work products.
* Partner with Product and design stakeholders to ensure application functionality is intuitive, reliable, and aligned with user workflows.
* Develop APIs, backend services, frontend components, and integration patterns that support platform interoperability.
* Help integrate applications with data services, AI-enabled capabilities, workflow configurations, authentication patterns, and enterprise systems.
* Contribute to reusable development patterns, documentation, and engineering practices that improve team velocity and consistency.
* Integrate data-driven, search, agentic, and AI-enabled capabilities into production web applications using well-defined APIs and reusable application patterns.

**Modern Development & AI-Enabled Engineering**

* Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and engineering analysis.
* Apply strong engineering judgment when using LLM-enabled workflows, ensuring generated or assisted code meets standards for quality, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Use AI-enabled tools where appropriate to support test generation, code review preparation, technical documentation, and developer productivity.

**DevOps, Reliability & Security**

* Contribute to Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, environment management, monitoring, and incident readiness.
* Build software using an Agile methodology, with strong attention to reliability, performance, availability, scalability, and operational support.
* Support observability practices including logging, monitoring, error handling, and production diagnostics.
* Follow secure development practices aligned with internal security standards, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and enterprise security expectations.
* Collaborate with Platform Reliability, Security, and Global Shared Services teams to support secure, reliable, and maintainable production systems.

**Collaboration & Technical Ownership**

* Work effectively with Product, Solution Engineering, Data & AI Engineering, Platform Reliability, Architecture, Security, and regional teams in a globally distributed environment.
* Take ownership of assigned features, services, defects, and technical improvements from design through production support.
* Communicate technical trade-offs clearly and contribute to pragmatic engineering decisions.
* Mentor less experienced engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, pairing, and shared engineering practices.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.
* Contribute actively within planning and design meetings, speaking up where potential issues arise or where a requirement is poorly defined.
* Champion potential solutions to problems and communicate them clearly to the team.

What we offer
  
  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
  
  
**About You**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience developing production software in application engineering, software engineering, platform engineering, or related technical roles.
* Strong production experience developing backend applications and services using C# and modern .NET.
* Experience designing REST APIs and building distributed or service-oriented application capabilities.
* Deep understanding of SQL and database optimisation.
* Experience building, modernizing, or operating scalable web applications in production environments, especially applications that support complex workflows, collaboration, reporting, document review, or customer-facing delivery.
* Experience building APIs, backend services, frontend components, integrations, and application capabilities in production environments.
* Experience developing, deploying, and supporting cloud-hosted applications, with practical experience in Microsoft Azure strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of software design, testing, code quality, maintainability, security, and performance.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, source control, code review, and modern software delivery practices.
* Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools or LLM-enabled coding workflows to improve development productivity.
* Ability to collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, Platform Reliability, and cross-functional stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong English communication skills and ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams.

**What Is Preferred**

* Experience in Search, RAG or AI integration technologies.
* Experience of real-time collaboration or data syncing with technologies such as SignalR or WebSockets.
* Experience in frontend systems such as React or Blazor.
* Experience in product-led or platform-based organizations.
* Familiarity with low-code or hybrid development environments.
* Experience with collaborative due diligence, document review, workflow, reporting, Q&A, risk management, or transaction delivery applications.
* Experience supporting interoperability across multiple systems or enterprise platforms.
* Experience working in a broader multi-cloud enterprise environment, including familiarity with AWS.
* Background in energy, infrastructure, renewables, assurance, certification, or other technically complex industries.
* Experience with multi-cloud environments spanning Azure and AWS.
* Experience modernizing legacy applications or integrating acquired software products into a broader enterprise platform.

Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.

The role requires strong hands-on experience across both disciplines: developing ETL/ELT pipelines, transforming structured and semi-structured data, and ensuring reliable data availability, as well as building RAG pipelines, integrating LLM-based solutions, and operationalizing models with MLOps best practices.
  
  
The candidate should be comfortable working with business stakeholders, data scientists, BI teams, product teams, and technical teams to understand requirements, design scalable data and AI solutions, and deliver measurable business value end to end — from raw data to production-ready AI features.
  
  
**Key Skills**

* 4+ years of experience spanning data engineering and AI/ML engineering, with strong exposure to data integration, ETL/ELT development, and cloud-based data and AI platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory for building, scheduling, monitoring, and managing data pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Azure Data Lake Storage for storing, organizing, and managing large volumes of data.
* Experience with Azure Databricks, including notebooks, Spark SQL, PySpark, data transformation, and performance optimization.
* Strong SQL and Python skills for querying, transformation, data validation, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Machine Learning or Azure AI Studio for training, deploying, and managing ML models.
* Practical experience with Azure OpenAI Service or similar LLM platforms, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and model integration.
* Experience building RAG pipelines using vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search, FAISS, Pinecone) for grounding LLM responses in enterprise data.
* Experience with ML/AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, LangChain, or Semantic Kernel.
* Good understanding of data lake architecture (bronze, silver, gold / medallion architecture) and MLOps practices (model versioning, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, retraining).
* Experience with data modelling, data quality checks, data profiling, reconciliation, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
* Exposure to DevOps practices such as Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), version control, and deployment processes.
* Working knowledge of Power BI or similar reporting tools, and knowledge of legacy ETL tools (Informatica, SSIS, Teradata, Oracle) will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure Databricks, SQL, and related technologies.
* Build automated ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, validate, and publish data for analytics, reporting, and AI model consumption.
* Design, build, and fine-tune machine learning and generative AI models to solve business problems, using the curated data pipelines as the foundation.
* Develop RAG pipelines and integrate LLM-based solutions with enterprise data sources and applications.
* Work with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured datasets, preparing them for both analytics and model training/evaluation.
* Develop data and model transformation logic using SQL, PySpark, Spark SQL, Databricks notebooks, and Python ML frameworks.
* Create and maintain reliable data flows and AI services across raw, curated, and consumption-ready layers, including production model inference.
* Perform data exploration, validation, reconciliation, model evaluation, and performance testing to ensure accuracy and reliability end to end.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, BI developers, product owners, and architects to convert requirements into technical data and AI solutions.
* Support data migration, system integration, and AI feature rollout, from legacy platforms to cloud-based data and AI platforms.
* Monitor pipeline and model performance in production, troubleshoot failures, optimize processing/inference cost and latency, and ensure timely availability.
* Implement data quality rules, responsible AI practices, exception handling, logging, audit checks, and operational controls.
* Contribute to documentation of data flows, model architecture, source-to-target mappings, technical designs, and operational support procedures.
* Participate in E2E product lifecycle activities including design, development, testing, deployment, run support, retraining, refactoring, and decommissioning of outdated solutions.
* Continuously improve existing data and AI engineering processes through automation, standardization, and reusable components.

**Business And Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of both data engineering and AI/ML concepts — data pipelines, data integration, data modelling, model lifecycle, and cloud-based platforms.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical designs spanning data and AI.
* Experience in working with data structures, storage systems, model architectures, data quality frameworks, and system integrations.
* Good understanding of enterprise data flows, upstream and downstream dependencies, and AI/reporting consumption patterns.
* Ability to quickly analyze existing data and AI solutions and recommend improvements, automation opportunities, or alternative approaches.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues across pipelines, databases, models, and application layers.
* Experience working in Agile teams with E2E ownership of deliverables, from data ingestion through to deployed AI features.
* Ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Good documentation skills, including technical design documents, model cards, process flows, data mapping, and support guides.

**General Skills**

* Strong team player with the ability to work independently when required.
* High ownership mindset with a focus on delivering reliable and scalable data and AI solutions.
* Open to learning new technologies and applying them to improve existing processes.
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Ability to understand end-to-end business processes and data/AI dependencies.
* Good communication skills with the ability to explain technical data and AI concepts in a simple and clear manner.
* Proactive approach toward automation, optimization, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate or postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications in Azure Data Engineering, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Machine Learning, or generative AI technologies will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Technology Stack**
**Cloud & Data Platform:**
Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks
  
  
**Cloud & AI Platform:**
Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Studio, Azure OpenAI Service
  
  
**Programming & Querying:**
SQL, Python, PySpark, Spark SQL
  
  
**AI/ML Frameworks:**
PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, LangChain, Semantic Kernel
  
  
**Data & AI Engineering:**
ETL, ELT, data pipelines, data modelling, data quality, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, MLOps
  
  
**Vector Search & Data:**
Azure AI Search, FAISS, Pinecone, vector databases
  
  
**BI & Reporting:**
Power BI, SSRS or equivalent visualization tools
  
  
**DevOps & Delivery:**
Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Agile delivery practices

Informatica, SSIS, Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server

title: Tech S and T- Tech Strategy - Senior consultant-GDSF04
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Strategy Consultant**
**THE OPPORTUNITY:**
EY's Technology Strategy & Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. Our technology practice is recognized by industry analysts as a leader in leveraging business and technology to drive strategic business-led, tech-enabled e2e transformation. We serve clients across all major industries and work with organizations of different sizes, helping guide them to achieve business success while delivering strategic IT value.
  
  
**Scope of engagements**
We are currently seeking experienced, seasoned IT Strategy practitioners who can be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and customer to devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. We are looking for folks who have experience in advising clients to …
  
  

* reset, reimagine and re-think their business and operating models with tech-enabled, cutting-edge solutions that re-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams
* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance

We work with clients to address issues of importance to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in creating value and delivering world-class IT capabilities to support futuristic business needs. Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst & Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high-profile clients with range of services including:
  
  

* Tech Strategy & Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* 3/5-year Transformation strategy, roadmaps & blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy & management
* M&A due-diligence, planning and post integration/separation
* Enterprise Architecture Services

**Key responsibilities of candidate include:**

* Understanding the business strategy & vision and translating them into enterprise-wide technology vision & strategy in alignment with strategic priorities for growth, customer experience, efficiency etc.
* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications
* Have strong experience in analysing business models, business model innovation/ incubation, and experience in one or more of the following areas preferred: Market Strategy, Pricing/ Monetization, Finance, Ecosystem Management, and/ or Product Management
* Ability to analyse client’s (IT) Operating Model including the organization structure, processes and governance while developing recommendations and/or creating actionable roadmaps
* Significant experience in: 1) developing business capability model for the enterprise; 2) analysing enterprise-wide portfolio of systems / platforms and 3) function as guardian of the transformation strategy and business architecture to make sure that new initiatives comply with strategic priorities
* Solid experience in guiding our clients through large, enterprise-wide transformation to implement their strategies and business architecture. Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.
* Leverage EY’s global network, and leverage the cross-functional expertise to develop relevant architecture insights

**Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:**

* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end-to-end services and effectively address their business challenges.
* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.
* Develop thought leadership and define approaches to provide structured solutions to complex technology strategy problems of clients, by recombining existing methodologies and teams
* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business - IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. They should provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing EY leadership of engagement status, and managing staff performance
* Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)
* Should be very good at using various tools (Such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, visualization tools, MS-Project, etc.)
* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point-of-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier-1 B-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 5+ years of relevant experience in large-scale, enterprise-wide transformations
* Min. of 5+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e-commerce, etc.
* Demonstrated experience of driving business workshops as well as conducting deep-dive technology workshops to collaboratively develop transformation vision, strategy, roadmaps and blueprints
* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models & organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT - business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end-to-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance
* Should have experience in designing and managing an effective IT governance framework across the spectrum of IT service delivery
* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies

**The following are preferred, but not required:**

* Advanced business and/or technology degrees from tier-1 schools (MBA, Masters)
* Experience in presenting directly to the C-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO
* Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.
* Speaking at industry conferences, round tables, and other public forums
* Authoring articles and white papers
* Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc
* Exposure across key technology domains is preferred (application, data, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, network. security etc)
* Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm
* Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).

**Overall Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of the current IT environment and industry IT trends to identify the engagement and client service issues.
* Ability to act as day-to-day client contact on the project engagement; run client status and other client meetings and deliver executive-level presentations that drive actions and decisions.
* Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; and manage the delivery of an engagement.
* Ability to identify opportunities and help generate sell-on work during client engagements by understanding a range services and offerings and coordinating with personnel in other service lines to help sell integrated solutions that meet client needs.
* Experience in creating points of view on relevant industry trends, solutions, methodologies, and analytical frameworks and tools to bring strategic perspectives to existing solutions.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The Principal Engineer - IT will be responsible for the design, implementation, administration, automation, and governance of Microsoft 365 and Identity platforms across the enterprise. * Design, implement, and support Microsoft 365 solutions including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Intune, and Microsoft Copilot.

* Configure, deploy, and manage Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and related cloud services in accordance with security and compliance requirements.
* Solid understanding of Intune MDM/MAM, On-Prem Active Directory, Group Policies concepts.
* Knowledge of Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Security and Compliance and best practices.
* Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, and cloud-native technologies to improve operational efficiency and scalability.
* Implement automation frameworks for identity, access management, reporting, provisioning, and administrative processes.
* Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure, and Operations teams to deliver secure and scalable enterprise solutions.
* Provide technical leadership and advanced troubleshooting support for Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and Identity-related services.
* Manage Microsoft 365 Copilot governance, licensing, access controls, agent governance, adoption, and support activities.
* Lead strategic Microsoft 365 and Identity platform initiatives, ensuring successful delivery and alignment with business objectives.
* Partner with security teams to implement enterprise security controls, Zero Trust principles, governance, and compliance requirements.
* Participate in security reviews, audit activities, risk assessments, and remediation efforts.
* Develop technical standards, operational procedures, documentation, and best practices.
* Stay current with Microsoft technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
* At least 12 years of experience in Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Management, and enterprise cloud technologies.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 services, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune MDM/MAM, Identity Governance, Conditional Access, and security best practices.
* Understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Privileged Identity Management concepts
* Experience with Azure AD roles and Conditional Access policies, MFA, and related administration skills
* Help team members with your expertise to achieve common goals.
* Proficient in PowerShell scripting and Exchange online, SharePoint Online and Entra ID administration.
* Certification in Microsoft 365 Fundamentals or Microsoft 365 Administrator is preferred.
* Solid understanding of Intune MDM/MAM, On-Prem Active Directly, Group Policies concepts.
* Knowledge of Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Security and Compliance and best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze directory and M365 services logs and derive meaningful insights.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and executive levels.
* Proactive mindset with a keen sense of ownership and the ability to work independently to drive initiative forward.

**Technical Skills**
**Primary Skills**

* Microsoft Entra ID
* Conditional Access
* Identity Governance
* Microsoft Graph API
* Exchange Online
* Microsoft Teams
* SharePoint Online
* OneDrive
* Microsoft Copilot

title: Senior Technology Lead, L4B Customer & Partner Experience
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
  
  
**Senior Technology Lead, L4B Customer & Partner Experience**
**The Role:**
The Sr. Technology Lead will work as a core member of the IT Digital Growth Solutions team to design, govern, and scale Logitech’s global Salesforce ecosystem, serving as a subject matter expert in Sales Cloud and CPQ/Revenue Cloud implementations. This position is based out of Chennai, India. You will serve as the primary technical authority, ensuring our Salesforce platform is robust, highly scalable, and strategically aligned to drive business transformation across the L4B Sales & Marketing organization.
  
  
**Your Contribution:**
Move fast. Speak up. Decide and own. Drive change. Exceed customer needs. These are some of the winning behaviors you’ll need for success at Logitech.
  
  
In this role you will:
  
  

* Solution Design & CPQ Architecture: Lead the technical solutioning and architectural roadmap for Salesforce Sales Cloud and CPQ/Revenue Cloud to power the Logitech for Business roadmap. Architect end-to-end Quote-to-Cash solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise business goals.
* AI Integration & Automation: Business-minded technologist who is not just an expert in today's platform but is excited about building the future. The ideal candidate sees the potential for AI and automation to transform this space and is eager to lead that charge, evolving from a traditional developer/technical architect into a domain-anchored AI operator over the next three years.
* Platform Governance: Collaborate with the Platform team on establishing and enforcing design standards, best practices, and code review processes to ensure technical excellence and platform stability.
* Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner with Digital Offi ce teams and Security, Sales, and Marketing teams to translate business requirements into high-level technical designs. Act as the bridge between technical implementation and business value.
* Solution Delivery: Oversee comprehensive Sales & marketing solution delivery, including complex integrations (e.g., ERP, PRM, Marketing Automation), ensuring data consistency and smooth cutover while technical debt is well-managed.
* Technical Mentorship: Mentor junior developers and administrators, fostering growth and technical maturity across the CRM team.

**Key Qualifications:**
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviors to our team:
  
  

* For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviors to our team:
* At least 10+ years experience working in the IT industry, with 7–10+ years of total Salesforce CRM experience
* 6+ years of experience designing complex, high transaction volume, enterprise-wide business solutions on the Salesforce Force.com platform using Apex, Visualforce and Lightning, including 5–8 years of dedicated CPQ experience
* 6+ years of experience with Salesforce.com's, support and service business processes with implementation experience in custom applications leveraging Salesforce Platform. Integration experience with other cloud based platforms and services, including any subscriptions system is a plus
* Solid understanding of best practices in CRM usage and ability to bring a consulting approach to help business solve issues and challenges
* Solid understanding of web technologies, such as HTTP, JavaScript, AJAX, HTML, DHTML, CSS and a strong understanding of Object-Oriented design and programming concepts
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Declarative, Programming and Administration (develop code, custom objects, Lightning components, Visualforce pages, Apex, reports, workfl ows, assignment rules, and more)
* Expertise in Sales Cloud, Quote-to-Cash and PRM business processes, with 3–5 years of Revenue Cloud / Multi-Cloud experience highly preferred.
* Knowledge of APEX triggers/SOQL queries and stored procedures
* Experience with Salesforce.com Web Services APIs
* Experience or Strong understanding of Salesforce Visualforce Sites and Communities
* Knowledge on Integration/Middleware tools such as Workato and MuleSoft
* Knowledge on integrated technologies Jira, Marketing Automation, Cloud Solutions is a plus

**Risk Management**

* Identify, manage, and mitigate delivery risks and issues proactively, ensuring timely escalation and resolution

**Governance**

* Address tech compliance (ESDLC) requirements through the delivery lifecycle (design reviews, security reviews, SAT, OAT, etc.) with support from HTL(Hive Tech Lead) / PO / CPO (Chief Product Owner)
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, operational, and enterprise governance standards across all engineering work
* Support audits, oversight reviews, and risk committees with accurate and timely reporting
* Drive adherence to engineering governance frameworks, including architecture governance, risk controls, security requirements, and delivery standards
* Contribute to and participate in governance forums to represent engineering delivery health, risks, and strategic needs
* Evaluates & refines AI-generated requirements / technical artefacts, ensuring strategic alignment, feasibility, & adherence to standards.

**Skills And Experience**

* 10+ years experinece in software engineering
* Java & Back-end Engineering Strong hands-on Java engineering experience, with a solid understanding of modern Java, Spring/Spring Boot, concurrency, application performance, dependency management, and building maintainable enterprise back-end services.
* API & Service Development Strong experience designing, building and evolving REST APIs and service-based architectures. Able to make good decisions around API contracts, versioning, authentication and authorisation, error handling, idempotency, resilience, observability and backward compatibility.

Experience with PostgreSQL and/or Oracle is preferred, but strong experience with comparable enterprise relational databases is acceptable.

Understands prompt and context engineering sufficiently to provide AI tools with the right code, architecture, constraints and engineering context, while critically validating their output.

**Additional Skills**
**Other Technical Skills**

* Event-driven and asynchronous architectures, messaging and integration patterns
* Containerisation and Kubernetes
* Cloud-native engineering
* Observability and application performance management
* Network fundamentals, particularly HTTP/TLS, DNS, proxies, load balancing and connectivity troubleshooting
* Web and application security

* Continuously develops engineering and leadership capability.
* Grows Others (People Leaders)

**AI Architect – Core Agentic AI**

Experience: 10–14 years total; 4+ years in ML/AI, including 2+ years building LLM and agentic systems in production

Function: Core AI Platform / Agentic AI CoE

Reports to: Head of AI / Chief Architect

Location: [Chennai / Bangalore] – Hybrid

Employment: Full-time

**Role summary**

The AI Architect owns the end-to-end technical architecture of our agentic AI platform: how agents reason, plan, call tools, remember, and stay safe at enterprise scale. You set the reference architecture, patterns and guardrails that every AI product team builds on, and you are the final technical authority on agent design choices.

**Key responsibilities**

**Architecture and design**

* Define the reference
  **architecture for single- and multi-agent systems**
  : orchestration, planning, tool use, memory, state, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Choose and justify agent patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, supervisor/worker, graph-based workflows) for each use case.
* Design the tool and integration layer, including
  **Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers**
  , function-calling contracts and enterprise API access.
* Architect retrieval and memory: RAG pipelines, hybrid search, vector and graph stores, short- and long-term agent memory.
* Set the model strategy: frontier API models vs. open-weight models, routing, fallbacks, fine-tuning vs. prompting, and cost/latency trade-offs.

**Platform, scale and reliability**

* Design for production: latency budgets, concurrency, caching, token cost controls, and graceful degradation.
* Define the LLMOps/AgentOps stack: tracing, evaluation, prompt and model versioning, observability and rollback.
* Establish evaluation frameworks covering task success, tool-call accuracy, hallucination rate, safety, and regression testing.

**Governance, security and Responsible AI**

* Build guardrails against prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool actions and over-permissioned agents.
* Define identity, authorization and audit for agents acting on behalf of users.
* Align designs with data privacy and AI regulation (e.g. DPDP Act, GDPR, EU AI Act where relevant) and internal Responsible AI policy.

**Leadership and influence**

* Run architecture reviews and write design docs, ADRs and reference implementations.
* Translate business problems into agentic solutions with clear ROI with product and business stakeholders.
* Evaluate emerging frameworks, models and vendors, and decide build vs. buy.
* Mentor senior engineers and grow architecture capability across teams.

**Must-have qualifications**

* 10–14 years in software engineering/architecture, with
  **4+ years in ML/AI and 2+ years shipping LLM-based or agentic systems to production.**
* Deep hands-on knowledge of LLM application design: prompting, function/tool calling, structured outputs, context management, RAG.
* Working experience with agent frameworks such as
  **LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex,**
  CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK or Claude Agent SDK.
* Experience with major
  **LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock)**
  and open-weight models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen).
* Strong distributed-systems background: microservices, event-driven design, APIs, queues, async workflows.
* **Vector databases and search**
  : Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.
* Cloud architecture on at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP, with Kubernetes and containerisation.
* Strong
  **Python,**
  working knowledge of Java, TypeScript or Go.
* Proven record of owning architecture decisions with measurable business outcomes.

**Good to have**

* MCP server design and agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AIA - AI Archictect- Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Architect**
**Enterprise GenAI, Agentic AI and AI Platform Architecture**
**Career Family AIA - AI / GenAI / Agentic AI**
**Role Type Full Time**
**The opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable and production-ready enterprise AI solutions. The role combines hands-on architecture with consulting leadership across Generative AI, Agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI/ML, cloud platforms and modern application engineering. The architect will translate business priorities into target-state architectures, reusable patterns and implementation roadmaps while guiding multidisciplinary teams from discovery through deployment and operationalization.
  
  
The ideal candidate has delivered enterprise or client-facing AI solutions in pre-production or production environments and can explain the use case, architecture, personal contribution, controls, delivery approach and outcomes. Certifications, personal projects and demonstrations alone are not sufficient.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead discovery and architecture workshops, clarify business outcomes and non-functional requirements, and convert them into scalable AI solution designs and delivery roadmaps.
* Architect LLM applications, copilots, RAG and Graph RAG solutions, autonomous agents, multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, memory patterns and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Define reference architectures and reusable patterns for document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, grounding, prompt workflows, model routing and enterprise integrations.
* Select fit-for-purpose models, cloud services, vector stores, orchestration frameworks and evaluation approaches based on security, quality, latency, cost, scalability and maintainability requirements.
* Design API-first, event-driven and microservices-based integrations with enterprise applications, data platforms, workflow systems and user experience layers.
* Establish AI evaluation and observability covering retrieval quality, groundedness, accuracy, hallucination risk, agent trajectories, tool execution, latency, cost and user experience.
* Embed Responsible AI, privacy, security and compliance controls including PII protection, access control, auditability, prompt-injection mitigation, content safety, secure tool execution and data-leakage prevention.
* Define cloud-native deployment and operations patterns using containers, Kubernetes or managed services, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, model/LLM operations, monitoring and release controls.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design reviews, code reviews and production-readiness assessments; troubleshoot complex issues and guide performance optimization.
* Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, data scientists, engineers, UX teams, security and platform teams to ensure alignment from design through adoption.
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, estimates, executive presentations, accelerators, reusable assets and AI practice development.
* Lead and mentor architects and engineers, promote engineering standards, and build capability through coaching and knowledge sharing.

**Skills And Attributes**
**Professional experience**

* 10+ years of experience in AI, data, analytics, software engineering or digital transformation, including significant responsibility for solution architecture and end-to-end delivery.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and deploying enterprise-scale AI/ML, GenAI, RAG or Agentic AI solutions in client-facing environments.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional teams, architecture governance, stakeholder engagement and complex delivery programs.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs and business value to technical and executive audiences.

**Technical Skills**

* Deep understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, Graph RAG, Agentic RAG, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, knowledge graphs, model evaluation and fine-tuning approaches.
* Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI or Google Agent SDK, and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Strong experience with at least one enterprise cloud AI ecosystem: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI; AWS Bedrock; or GCP Vertex AI and Gemini. Multi-cloud exposure is preferred.
* Experience with data and AI platforms such as Databricks, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, BigQuery or equivalent enterprise data services.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; working knowledge of REST APIs, FastAPI, JSON, asynchronous processing, microservices and event-driven architecture.
* Experience with vector databases, enterprise search, relational and NoSQL data stores, caching and analytics stores.
* Understanding of ML, deep learning, NLP, predictive analytics and the end-to-end AI lifecycle.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, MLOps, LLMOps, observability and production support.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture, data governance, model risk, Responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, accessibility and regulatory controls.

**Consulting And Leadership Skills**

* Strong client engagement, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, presentation and executive communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, high-quality technical architectures and phased implementation plans.
* Leadership in solution estimation, delivery governance, risk management, quality assurance, mentoring and capability building.
* Curiosity, structured problem-solving, commercial awareness and commitment to continuous learning.

**Education And Preferred Certifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline.
* Relevant certifications in Azure AI, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, AI/ML, Generative AI or enterprise architecture are preferred.

**Why join us**

* Be at the forefront of AI-driven innovation across multiple client sectors.
* Work with global clients to deliver measurable business impact.
* Collaborate with AI experts, analytics leaders and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We provide insights, coaching and confidence to help you become the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be empowered to use your voice and help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Cyber- DT&P- Infrastructure - AI Security Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
AI Security Consultant, Infrastructure
  
  
As an AI Security Consultant specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As an AI Security Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for
  
  

* Build secure AI landing-zone components across cloud accounts or subscriptions, networks, identity, compute, Kubernetes, model services and observability.
* Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
* Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
* Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.
* Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
* Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort and estimation inputs to pursuits.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  
  

* Ability to independently lead a technical workstream and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
* Clear communication of architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, risks and implementation status to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Ability to guide consultants, review technical work and create a collaborative delivery environment.
* Strong demonstration and technical storytelling skills for workshops, prototypes and client readouts.

The team
  
  
Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.
  
  
We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.
  
  
Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation and observability.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 2+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience, including hands-on production work in both domains.
* Hands-on experience designing, integrating and securing production generative AI, RAG or agentic workloads, including model, tool and enterprise data connections.
* Hands-on depth in AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, with working knowledge of infrastructure security patterns in the other major cloud platforms.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and securing cloud and network infrastructure, Kubernetes or container platforms, and production AI or model-serving workloads.
* Strong knowledge of network segmentation, private connectivity, egress controls, DNS, TLS, firewalls, gateways, service meshes and enterprise integration patterns.
* Implementation experience with Terraform or comparable IaC, CI/CD pipelines, policy-as-code, Kubernetes RBAC, network policies, admission controls and secrets.
* Ability to design, build and review infrastructure automation using Python, Go, Bash, PowerShell or a comparable language, together with HCL or YAML, Git and CI/CD tooling.
* Ability to travel 25% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and engagements you serve.

Preferred:
  
  

* Previous consulting, client delivery or customer-facing engineering experience.
* Experience across both managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
* Experience with AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices or AI-specific monitoring.
* Experience developing reusable technical assets, guiding junior engineers or contributing to engineering standards.
* Familiarity with the broader machine learning lifecycle and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or MLflow.
* Experience with AI platforms and model-serving technologies such as Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore or SageMaker AI; Microsoft Foundry or Azure Machine Learning; Google Vertex AI; vLLM; KServe; NVIDIA Triton or NIM; Ray Serve; or comparable platforms.
* Experience securing GPU infrastructure, model and container registries, software supply chains, signed artifacts, service meshes or multi-tenant inference environments.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CKA, CKS, or cloud and Terraform certifications

Closing Date: 10/28/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
  
  
**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**VPU Context**
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations.
  
  
For more information on ITS, see video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w
  
  
**Unit Context**
The WBG Corporate Solutions Department (ITSCO) is focused on the digital transformation of essential corporate services to ensure WBG operations are seamless, resilient, and future ready. Uniting digitalization roadmaps, experience design, process optimization, application delivery, systems management, and technology modernization across 70+ products, the department links business ambition with operational excellence - from intuitive employee experiences and precision payroll to data-driven decision making, intelligent automation, and AI enablement. The unit will oversee vital corporate systems such as personnel administration, global payroll, benefits, tax, pension, budget and planning, cost and expense management, internal audit, ethics and justice processes, heath services, and other essential corporate services. These operations—and their supporting platforms—demand uncompromising accuracy, confidentiality, and resilience, operating in environments where reliability is non-negotiable.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect leads the execution of strategic business requirements by designing integrated, AI-ready technology solutions and guiding their implementation across software, data, and cloud infrastructure. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role synthesizes business, information, and technical perspectives to create scalable architectures aligned with enterprise principles. By evaluating functionality, constraints, and compatibility across platforms, it ensures interoperability, stability, usability, and high availability in distributed environments, enabling corporate application teams to deliver with greater velocity, quality, and efficiency.
  
  

* Translate budget policy changes and new WBP requirements into functional and technical specifications for planning models, allocation rules, workflows, and approval routing.
* Define integration patterns between the planning tools, SAP ERP/FM, HR position data, and the enterprise data platform, keeping one consistent version of budget and actuals.
* Design, configure, and support planning applications in Jedox, including cubes, rules, Integrator jobs, and web reports and forms, alongside other periphal enterprise tools in use.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for SAP BW on HANA data models, planning functions,
* Partner with data engineering teams to integrate budget, actuals, and commitment data into the enterprise reporting tools such as Azure Databricks
* Deliver trusted budget-versus-actual, trajectory, and performance reporting for WBP, VPU budget teams, and senior management.
* Identify and shape AI-enabled opportunities, such as anomaly detection in budget submissions, forecasting support, and natural-language access to budget data, with responsible AI and human oversight built in.

Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Engineering, or a related field with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; OR a Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in enterprise planning, budgeting systems, or SAP BI; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Advanced expertise in areas – Data Analysis, Data Engineering, Reporting and Planning.
* Required Certifications: Scaled Agile certification (SAFe Architect, SAFe POPM, or SAFe Agilist); Any of the data technology such as Azure Synapse, Databricks or SAP BW/4HANA or SAP BW on HANA (or equivalent SAP BI/HANA certification); Any of the data engineering such as Databricks, Azure, GCP
* Recommended: Jedox Certified Modeler or Jedox Certified Consultant;
* Optional: TOGAF, or a public financial management credential (e.g., CIPFA, IPSAS certificate).

description:

In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. title: Enterprise Architect
description:
**About The Opportunity**
We are seeking an Enterprise Architect to help lead the architecture change process governed by our Architecture Review Board (ARB). In this role you will evaluate proposed solutions across the full enterprise architecture landscape — Business, Data, Application, and Technology (BDAT) — assess them against our architecture principles, standards, and target-state roadmaps, and guide project and solution teams toward designs that are sound, secure, cost-effective, and strategically aligned.
  
  
This is a breadth-first role with depth in at least one domain. You will spend less time building systems and more time shaping how systems fit together, why they should exist, and what the enterprise should stop doing. You will need to be equally credible talking about a value stream with a business VP and a network topology with an infrastructure engineer.
  
  
Our environment includes on-premises data centers, mainframe workloads deployed to cloud, and a substantial Microsoft Azure footprint, so practical hybrid-enterprise experience matters.
  
  
**Your Day-to-Day At Sagent**
****Architecture Governance and the Review Board****

* Co-lead the intake, triage, and review of architecture change requests entering the ARB, ensuring each submission has the artifacts, context, and analysis needed for an informed decision.
* Assess proposals against enterprise architecture principles, reference architectures, standards, and target-state roadmaps; identify risks, gaps, dependencies, and overlaps with existing capabilities.
* Facilitate ARB sessions: frame the decision, surface trade-offs, drive to a clear outcome, and prevent reviews from becoming design workshops.
* Author and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), conditional approvals, and time-bound exceptions or waivers, including the remediation path attached to each exception.
* Track accepted architecture risk and technical debt created through waivers, and report on it to governance and leadership forums.
* Evolve the governance process itself — review criteria, submission templates, fast-track paths for low-risk changes, and the definition of what does and does not require ARB review.
* Coach solution architects, engineers, and product teams so that proposals arrive review-ready and the standards are understood before designs are drawn.

****Business Architecture****

* Develop and maintain business capability models, value streams, and business process views, and use them to map where technology investment actually lands.
* Trace proposed changes back to business drivers, outcomes, and capability gaps; challenge initiatives that cannot articulate the capability they improve.
* Partner with business stakeholders and product owners to translate strategy and operating-model changes into architecture requirements and roadmap implications.
* Perform capability-based gap analysis between current and target state, and help sequence transition architectures that deliver value incrementally.

****Data Architecture****

* Define and govern enterprise data architecture: conceptual and logical data models, canonical and reference data, data domains, and authoritative sources of record.
* Review proposed changes for data integration patterns, data movement, latency and consistency requirements, lineage, and downstream impact on analytics and reporting.
* Partner with data governance, privacy, and security functions on data classification, retention, residency, sovereignty, and regulatory obligations.
* Guide the architecture of analytics and data platforms, including data warehouse, lakehouse, streaming, and master data management approaches, and the boundaries between operational and analytical estates.
* Reduce data duplication and point-to-point sprawl by promoting shared data services, contracts, and interoperability standards.

****Application Architecture****

* Maintain the application portfolio and its architecture views; lead rationalization efforts using lifecycle assessment (for example, tolerate / invest / migrate / eliminate) to reduce redundancy and cost.
* Define application reference architectures and patterns: integration and API strategy, event-driven and messaging patterns, service boundaries, modularity, and modernization approaches for legacy and mainframe-hosted workloads.
* Guide build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions, including SaaS evaluation, extensibility and lock-in considerations, and the total cost of ownership over the asset's life.
* Ensure proposed applications and integrations meet non-functional requirements — availability, scalability, performance, observability, resilience, and supportability — and that those requirements are stated explicitly rather than assumed.
* Set standards for API management, interface contracts, and versioning so integrations remain governable as the portfolio changes.

****Technology Architecture****

* Own and evolve technology reference architectures and standards spanning compute, platform, network, and infrastructure services across on-premises, hybrid, and Azure environments.
* Provide architectural direction for cloud and hybrid network design, including segmentation, connectivity between data centers, cloud-hosted mainframe workloads, and Azure landing zones.
* Embed security and identity architecture into designs: zero-trust principles, network segmentation, encryption in transit and at rest, identity and access management, and secrets management.
* Set expectations for resilience, disaster recovery, and business continuity — recovery objectives, failover patterns, and the architectural evidence required to demonstrate them.
* Maintain a technology lifecycle view and technology radar: what is emerging, standard, contained, or being retired, and the roadmap for eliminating unsupported components.
* Partner with platform and DevOps teams on Infrastructure as Code, automation, and reference implementations so that approved patterns are the easiest ones for teams to adopt.

**Cross-Cutting Responsibilities**

* Apply a structured architecture method (TOGAF ADM or equivalent) proportionally — enough rigor to make good decisions, not so much that delivery stalls.
* Maintain the architecture repository, metamodel, and artifact standards so that views across BDAT stay connected and current rather than becoming shelfware.
* Contribute to multi-year architecture roadmaps and to portfolio and investment planning, including cost optimization, licensing, and cloud consumption efficiency (FinOps).
* Communicate architecture positions to audiences ranging from engineering teams to executive leadership, adjusting altitude and vocabulary without losing accuracy.
* Influence outcomes without direct authority, building the working relationships that make governance feel like support rather than obstruction.

****We'd Love to Hear from You If You Have****
****Education****

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

**Experience**

* Significant experience in enterprise, domain, or solution architecture, including demonstrable work across at least three of the four BDAT domains and deep expertise in at least one.
* Direct experience participating in or supporting an Architecture Review Board, design authority, or comparable governance body — including making a recommendation that was unpopular and defending it well.
* Experience developing architecture artifacts that were actually used: capability models, current- and target-state views, roadmaps, reference architectures, and decision records.
* Hands-on background in a hybrid enterprise environment spanning on-premises infrastructure and a major public cloud, with practical Azure experience strongly preferred.
* Experience with application portfolio rationalization, integration architecture, or large-scale modernization of legacy or mainframe-hosted workloads.
* Exposure to regulated or audited environments and the compliance obligations that shape architecture decisions.

****Certifications****

* TOGAF certification (Foundation or Practitioner) strongly preferred; equivalent frameworks such as Zachman, ArchiMate certification, or SAFe Architect are also valued.
* Azure Solutions Architect Expert or comparable cloud architecture certification.
* Certifications in security, data, or integration domains are a plus (for example, CISSP, CCSP, CDMP).

**Skills**

* Strong grasp of enterprise integration patterns, API and event-driven architecture, and the trade-offs between them.
* Solid data architecture fundamentals: modeling, master and reference data, data governance, and analytics platform patterns.
* Working knowledge of Azure PaaS and SaaS services, networking, identity, and security controls, plus core networking concepts including routing, VPNs, firewalls, and load balancing.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code and automation tooling (Terraform, PowerShell, Python) sufficient to review designs credibly and collaborate with platform teams.
* Ability to evaluate and articulate cost, risk, and TCO implications of architecture options in terms a business sponsor can act on.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to make a complex trade-off legible on a single page.
* Strong facilitation skills and the composure to run a room where stakeholders disagree.
* Analytical rigor balanced with pragmatism — able to say "good enough for now, and here's what we'll revisit" and mean it.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity, incomplete information, and competing priorities.
* Collaborative and credible with both technical practitioners and business leaders; able to work independently and as part of a team.

****Perks!****
As a Sagent Associate, you will be eligible to participate in our benefit programs beginning on Day #1! We offer a comprehensive package including Remote/Hybrid workplace options, Health Benefits, Unlimited Flexible Time Off, Family Planning Services, Tuition Reimbursement, Paid Family Leave, 401(k) Matching, Pet Insurance, In-person and Virtual Social Experiences, Career Pathing, Focus Time Fridays and much, much more!
  
  
****Why Sagent?****
Sagent is transforming the mortgage servicing industry by bringing the modern experience customers now expect from loan originations to loan servicing. Our platform lets customers manage their home-owing lives from anywhere while giving servicers lower costs, scale compliance and higher servicing values through full market cycles.
  
  
Sagent is a joint venture that combines Fiserv Inc.'s decades of market-leading fintech expertise with Warburg Pincus' skill in growing technology companies. We hire innovators and doers to disrupt the last and most complex frontier of lending and housing. We're growing fast and need you to help shape our future.
  
  
**Sagent is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.**
****Why you'll LOVE Sagent****
You could work anywhere. We know you are talented and looking for something inspiring and impactful. A place where you will make a difference and have a great time doing it!
  
  
By choosing Sagent, you can be part of our mission to make loans and homeownership simpler and safer for all consumers.
  
  
Sagent powers servicers and consumers. You power Sagent!
